newsitem.title: USA: Kornblum to visit Bosnia this week.
newsitem.headline: Kornblum to visit Bosnia this week.

text.p: U.S. Bosnia envoy John Kornblum will visit the Balkans this week and attend the inaugural sessions of the new Bosnian presidency and the parliament's house of representatives, the State Department said Tuesday.
Kornblum, the assistant secretary of state for European and Canadian affairs, plans to leave Washington Wednesday and stop first in Paris for bilateral talks, the department said.
He meets Croatian President Franjo Tudjman in Zagreb and then travels to Sarajevo for the presidency and house of representatives' sessions on Sunday.
Kornblum plans to return to Washington on Sunday.
